CustomField.description: When true, the formTemplate runtime suppresses the progress / stage indicator entirely regardless of Stage Indicator Type. When false the indicator renders per Stage Indicator Type once the template has enough pages (3+ for most types).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to hide the page progress indicator and give the form a cleaner, single-page feel. Leave unchecked to show users where they are in a multi-page form.
CustomField.label: Hide Stage Indicator
